title: OrgsListInvitationsConfig
description: Authoring-time configuration. `orgId` is optional (default: the run's workspace root). Authorization is never configured here: it is the run's acting user holding host:members:manage in the target org (the SAME predicate the /orgs/:orgId/invites routes use), checked in the host surface.

orgId.description: Org to list (default: the run's workspace root).
